purpose: Choose the highest-value bounded PSI-1000 mirror-room work whenever a project is foreground-idle while preserving fairness, exploration, preemption and project scope.

ranking.method: bounded multi-objective priority score plus hard gates

portfolio_policy.explanation: No more than 70% of long-run idle budget may remain in known high-score exploit families; at least 20% is reserved for underexplored project-relevant hypotheses and 10% for urgent newly-arrived evidence or regressions.
portfolio_policy.starvation_action: raise priority for eligible under-served PSI strata unless a hard reject applies
portfolio_policy.critical_regression_override: a reproducible security, correctness, data-loss, rollback or severe reliability regression outranks ordinary capability optimization

plateau_policy.action_after_no_gain: exponential backoff for the hypothesis family and require materially new evidence, mechanism or project change before high-priority retry
plateau_policy.action_after_repeated_failure: quarantine hypothesis family for manual/research review while retaining negative results
plateau_policy.success_saturation: when measured marginal gain falls below project significance threshold, redirect idle budget to another eligible PSI stratum

project_fairness.scope: only among projects already eligible for background improvement
project_fairness.rule: foreground activity always dominates; among independently idle projects use weighted fair sharing constrained by user/project priority and resource locality
project_fairness.cross_project_resource_borrowing: allowed only if source project has no eligible work and borrowing does not violate reservations or policy

capability_vector.regression_rule: a gain in one dimension cannot compensate for failure of a non-compensable invariant

anti_gaming: scheduler score is not itself an acceptance metric
candidate may not modify its own ranking evidence without independent verification
benchmark-specific gains cannot erase broader regressions
repeated easy wins cannot starve hard high-value strata
proposer and challenger do not choose final promotion authority
resource accounting includes failed and rejected experiments

essential_priority.hard_rule: An unresolved paired ESS level or a regressed previously-signed ESS level is promoted ahead of optional capability polish in the affected PSI domain unless a more severe non-compensable incident elsewhere overrides it.
essential_priority.evidence_reuse: PSI may reuse exact current evidence, but ESS completion requires its own independent closure signature.
essential_priority.stale_evidence: Stale ESS evidence reopens the essential and restores essential-first scheduling priority.
essential_priority.disabled_capability_rule: A disabled optional capability still requires its ESS safe-disabled control path and cannot be skipped as not-applicable.
